posts.title: Fall 2026 Newsletter 1
posts.author: Grant Talbert
posts.excerpt: I hope everyone is having a great end of their summer. Here at BUMA, we've been hard at work trying to make the coming school year something special. Here's what's new this year, and a peek into our upcoming schedule.

posts.title: \(L^1\) Geometry
posts.author: Katherine Guo
posts.excerpt: In mathematics, a metric is an abstraction of the notion of distance. There are an important class of metrics, called \(L^p\) metrics, where \(p\) is either a positive integer, or \(\infty\). We will focus on the \(L^1\) metric, and will explore common geometric constructions using this new version of distance. We will explore some questions about \(L^1\) geometry.

posts.title: A Friendly Introduction to Abstract Nonsense
posts.author: Grant Talbert
posts.excerpt: Category theory is a unifying language for mathematics, which explains striking connections between distant branches of math. These notes introduce categories, functors, natural transformations, and universal constructions, guided by examples from basic set theory and algebra.
